notes: Local gates passed on 2026-08-12: mise run env:check, lint:v2, typecheck:v2, test:v2 (24/24), test:v2:browser (16/16 across four required viewports), build:renderer (143 modules), format:check, git diff --check, and the full mise run check. Full-gate baseline classifier, Windows test-harness, Mise contract, and DEP0040 checker gaps were proven pre-existing from Git history and repaired narrowly with fail-closed focused regressions; no Rust, Tauri, native configuration, product behavior, or release-script expansion was made. The pinned library's filterResolution=1 enhancement path remains bounded to one small live=false selected lens with a CSS fallback, but requires real WebView2 performance validation outside this task. No Tauri desktop launch, interactive desktop automation, screenshot review, push, or pull request was performed.
